services.desc: There’s always something to do in Kilgore and if you like the outdoors then you’re in luck, as the Kilgore Parks and Facilities Department offers so many wonderful parks and facilities for all ages. Harris Street Park and Friendship Playground feature a pavilion, picnic tables, playground, restrooms, tennis court and walking trail. A very popular spot at Kilgore City Park is the Skate Park, which offers a partial bowl, half pipe, raised platforms and more. The park also offers a Splash Pad. The Lazy Splash Ranch is a free splash pad that is open during the hotter months of the year. blurb: This beautiful garden is modeled after the original Shakespeare Garden in England. Built to complement the Texas Shakespeare Festival, each of the plants and shrubs grown is referenced in one of Shakespeare’s plays. Open daily, the garden is located at Brook Drive and US Highway 259 on the Kilgore College Campus.
